svg.title: Four PID forms fed the same inputs
svg.desc: The positional form with its three rules equals Control.PID at every update; the form that keeps the applied torque leaves the limit at once and ends 4.30 newton-metres lower; without the gain rule the torque jumps 0.78 newton-metres when Kp changes from 16 to 24.
svg.text: Four PID forms fed the same inputs
Control Studio recording of this project · 1.5 rad step at 1.00 s · Kp 16 → 24 at 2.00 s · numbers answer the predictions
Keeping 20 N·m: leaves the limit at 1.02 s;
Control.PID stays at 20 N·m until 1.10 s
Kp 16 → 24: no gain rule jumps 0.78 N·m
